description: This Python source file defines the MemoryNotesRepository class, which provides a thread-safe in-memory implementation for storing, retrieving, updating, and deleting Note objects. It includes methods for listing notes with pagination, getting a note by ID, creating new notes, updating existing notes, and deleting notes, primarily intended for testing or demo purposes.

classes.name: MemoryNotesRepository
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory repository for managing Note objects, providing basic CRUD operations with synchronization to handle concurrent access.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a reentrant lock and an empty dictionary for notes.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(self, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Returns a list of notes with support for pagination parameters `limit` and `offset`, sorted deterministically by creation time and ID.

methods.name: Optional[Note] get_note(self, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its UUID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Note create_note(self, data: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new Note object from provided data and stores it in the repository.

methods.name: Optional[Note] update_note(self, note_id: UUID, data: NoteUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by UUID, modifying title and/or content if provided, and sets an updated timestamp.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a note by its UUID, returning True if deletion was successful.
